description: No clean concept. Strongest in early games (about 5-9 stones) right after the opponent plays into column 3 (or 0/2), when the opponent's stones sit low in columns 2-3 (and 0), none of theirs in column 1, and mine are on the right edge (column 6) or column 1 rather than column 0. Every extra stone, especially in columns 4-5, dilutes it; it rarely fires late in the game. Move-order sensitive.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to zero or to its maximum shifts move probabilities by at most about 0.04-0.09 (slight tilt from column 1 toward column 4 in one position).
notes: Layer 1. Tried: last-move cell lookup (F1 0.10), column-count templates (0.16, 0.15), cell enrichment template (0.15), plus last-move/my-last/their-previous move columns (0.18, 0.21; AUROC 0.69, sim share 0.09). Minimal pairs show an additive, stone-count-diluted vote over move tokens in short games, but context interactions in longer games (last-move effect changes with board) are not captured. Not mirror symmetric; same board via different move order gives different values. Synthesis reaches the dev max (2.132) but does not exceed it. Possibly a random direction or mixture.
